name: Subaru Outback 2010 2.5i CVT
notes: Subaru Select Monitor memory reads (service A8, one address per request) over CAN 11-bit 500 kbit/s. Each address answered a driveway probe on 2026-10-01 (engine off, idling, and through an engine start). Status: verified = confirmed against an independent signal while driving; candidate = answers, scaling consistent with idle readings and earlier recordings; assumed-scale = answers, scaling not yet seen move; raw = scaling unknown, logged as the raw byte; no-information = answers but never changes.

sensors.name: Engine oil temperature
sensors.evidence: Raw 0x78 (80 °C) at warm idle with coolant at 82 °C. Earlier recordings move in whole-degree Celsius steps and trail coolant on warm-up.

sensors.name: Learned ignition timing correction
sensors.evidence: Answers one byte (0x03 at idle, unchanged through an engine start). Scaling not established, so it is logged as the raw byte.

sensors.name: CVT fluid temperature
sensors.evidence: Raw 0x6E (70 °C) at warm idle. Earlier recordings move in whole-degree Celsius steps.

sensors.name: Torque converter turbine speed
sensors.evidence: Raw 0x14 = 640 rpm at idle in Park with engine speed 681 rpm. Earlier recordings move in 32 rpm steps.

sensors.name: Lock-up clutch duty
sensors.evidence: Earlier drive recordings take values in 0.5 % steps between 0 and 99.5 %.

sensors.name: AWD transfer clutch duty
sensors.evidence: Answers (0 at idle). Scaling assumed to match the lock-up duty until seen moving.

sensors.name: Front wheel speed (transmission)
sensors.evidence: Earlier drive recordings are whole km/h (e.g. 12 and 15 km/h).

sensors.name: Rear wheel speed (transmission)
sensors.evidence: Answers but reads 0 in every recording, including at 80 mph. Use the ABS/VDC rear axle speed instead.

sensors.name: Front axle mean speed (ABS/VDC)
sensors.evidence: Earlier drive recordings are whole km/h and track vehicle speed.

sensors.name: Rear axle mean speed (ABS/VDC)
sensors.evidence: Earlier drive recordings are whole km/h and track vehicle speed.

sensors.name: Front-to-rear rotation ratio
sensors.evidence: Raw 0x80 at rest; earlier recordings show 1.024 at rest.

sensors.name: Transmission fluid deterioration
sensors.evidence: Answers but is always 0, so a genuine zero can't be told from an unfilled value.
